fib: ______ is a broad field of interest in which the physical, emotional and intellectual characteristics and development of youngsters from pre-natal stage onwards are studied.
Developmental psychology

Among such approaches

______ refers to the process of growing up into a human being, a process which necessitates contact with other people.
Socialization
Socialization refers to the process of growing up into a human being, a process which necessitates contact with other people.
______ is the study of patterns of interrelationship existing in a group of people.
Sociometry
Sociometry is the study of patterns of interrelationship existing in a group of people.
______ refers to changes in structure and function.
concept of development
The concept of development refers to changes in structure and function.
